description: Update an existing signal — edit its status, linked opportunity, source, or other fields. At least one field must be provided. Requires `write` scope.

archived.description: Set true to soft-archive this signal; false to restore it.

body.description: Updated full text of the signal.

id.description: ID of the signal to update.

opportunityId.description: ID of the opportunity this signal is linked to.

requesterContact.description: Contact details for the requester (email, Slack handle, etc.).

requesterName.description: Name of the person who surfaced this signal.

source.description: Where the signal came from. Allowed: client | sales | stakeholder | internal | strategy.

status.description: Signal status. Allowed: NEW | TRIAGED | LINKED | ARCHIVED.

title.description: New short summary of the signal.

name: anyforge_update_signal
title: Update signal
